rules.sunday: Unscheduled. Free ONLY if the week was cleared. Otherwise every missed topic lands here.
rules.overflow_marking: Topics cleared on an overflow Sunday are marked status='rushed', NOT 'done'.
rules.rushed_handling: Any topic with rushed=true is auto-queued for an extra revision pass in P4 and cannot count toward 'mastered'.
rules.topic_completion: A topic is done only when every listed resource is complete. Partial = partial.
rules.mcq_threshold: Below 60% on a topic's MCQ set -> topic re-queued, rushed flag set.
rules.regeneration: This calendar is an OUTPUT, not a contract. Regenerate from remaining-topics + remaining-days whenever the plan slips.
